Dr. Martinez, patient Robert Kim (age 41) presents with: Bipolar I disorder, manic episode with psychotic features, stabilized on lithium + olanzapine, day 7 inpatient. Relevant history: Bipolar I disorder (diagnosed age 25, 3 prior hospitalizations); Previous lithium toxicity (2023, renal dose adjustment); Hypothyroidism secondary to lithium (levothyroxine 75mcg). Current medications: Lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L today), Olanzapine 15mg QHS, Levothyroxine 75mcg daily, and 1 more.

The patient is approaching discharge. Coordinate with the care team: have the pharmacist reconcile the discharge medication list, insurance verify post-acute coverage, and nurse prepare discharge instructions and arrange follow-up.

Clinical calibration instructions: Pharmacist should call review_medication_list for the patient. Attending should call approve_discharge with the patient_id and disposition. Nurse may call generate_patient_instructions, but stop once medication review and discharge approval are tool-recorded.

Please reconcile the discharge medication list for Robert Kim (PT-38745), age 41, with Bipolar I disorder currently on lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, and levothyroxine 75mcg daily. Verify dosing appropriateness given his history of lithium toxicity (2023) and current lithium level of 0.8 mEq/L. Check for any drug interactions and ensure renal dosing is appropriate. Report back with any concerns before discharge.

Patient Robert Kim (PT-38745) is being discharged following inpatient treatment for bipolar I disorder manic episode. Please verify post-acute coverage for: 1) Outpatient psychiatric follow-up, 2) Continued lithium and olanzapine prescriptions, and 3) Any prior authorization requirements. Patient has Cigna PPO. Report back with coverage details and any authorization needs before discharge.

Patient Robert Kim (PT-38745) is ready for discharge following stabilization of bipolar I disorder manic episode. Please prepare comprehensive discharge instructions including: medication regimen (lithium 900mg BID, olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily), signs of relapse to monitor, lithium toxicity warnings, and scheduled follow-up appointments. Arrange outpatient psychiatric follow-up within 1 week and labs for lithium level in 5-7 days. Coordinate with pharmacy for medication delivery and provide patient education materials. Report back when discharge packet is ready.

Discharge nursing tasks complete for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Generated comprehensive patient instructions covering medication regimen, relapse monitoring, and lithium toxicity warnings. Scheduled psychiatric follow-up within 1 week and lithium level labs in 5-7 days. Patient notification sent. Awaiting pharmacy medication reconciliation before final discharge approval.

Dr. Martinez, nursing discharge tasks are complete for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Patient instructions generated, psychiatric follow-up scheduled within 1 week, lithium level lab scheduled for 5-7 days post-discharge, and patient notified. Awaiting pharmacist medication reconciliation before final discharge approval.

Acknowledged. Thank you for completing the nursing discharge preparation. I confirm we are awaiting pharmacy medication reconciliation and insurance verification before final discharge approval. Please hold the discharge packet pending those clearances.
Understood, Dr. Martinez. I will hold the discharge packet and await clearance from pharmacy and insurance before releasing it to the patient.

Please update on medication reconciliation status for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Verify lithium 900mg BID dosing given history of lithium toxicity and current level 0.8 mEq/L, check renal dosing appropriateness, review drug interactions with olanzapine 15mg QHS and levothyroxine 75mcg. Report any concerns before discharge approval.

Pharmacist, please provide immediate status update on medication reconciliation for Robert Kim (PT-38745). We are holding discharge pending your review. Confirm safety of current regimen: lithium 900mg BID (level 0.8 mEq/L), olanzapine 15mg QHS, levothyroxine 75mcg daily, given his 2023 lithium toxicity history. Verify renal dosing appropriateness and drug interactions. We need your clearance to proceed with discharge.

Reviewing medication reconciliation for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Current lithium 900mg BID at level 0.8 mEq/L is within therapeutic range (0.6-1.2 mEq/L). Given his 2023 toxicity history, I'm checking renal function and drug interactions to ensure safe discharge dosing.

Medication reconciliation complete for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Current lithium level 0.8 mEq/L is within therapeutic range (0.6-1.2). No significant drug-drug interactions identified between lithium, olanzapine, and levothyroxine. Lorazepam 1mg PRN is listed but not used in 48h. Renal dosing appears appropriate given current lithium level and absence of acute kidney injury indicators. Discharge regimen is safe for continuation. No pharmacy flags or concerns identified.

I have completed final EMR verification. Robert Kim (PT-38745) is medically cleared for discharge with psychiatric stabilization achieved. Medication reconciliation shows lithium 0.8 mEq/L within therapeutic range, no drug interactions, and safe dosing. Please release the discharge packet and provide patient education. The patient may be discharged home with scheduled outpatient psychiatric follow-up within 1 week and lithium level recheck in 5-7 days.

Insurance verification is still pending for Robert Kim's post-acute coverage. Please hold discharge until we receive insurance clearance. I will approve discharge once insurance confirms coverage details.

Insurance verification for Robert Kim (PT-38745) is still pending. Please provide immediate update on post-acute coverage verification for outpatient psychiatric follow-up and continued lithium/olanzapine prescriptions. Confirm Cigna PPO coverage details and any prior authorization requirements. We are holding discharge pending your clearance.

I am verifying post-acute coverage for Robert Kim (PT-38745) with Cigna PPO. I will check coverage for outpatient psychiatric follow-up, continued lithium and olanzapine prescriptions, and identify any prior authorization requirements.

Coverage verification complete for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Cigna PPO eligibility confirmed for outpatient psychiatric follow-up and continued lithium/olanzapine prescriptions. Prior authorization is REQUIRED for these post-acute services. To process the pre-authorization, please provide: relevant diagnosis codes (ICD-10), procedure/treatment codes (CPT), and medical necessity documentation. Discharge cannot be finalized until pre-authorization is approved.

Coverage verification for Robert Kim (PT-38745) requires prior authorization. I have requested necessary documentation including diagnosis codes (ICD-10), procedure/treatment codes (CPT), and medical necessity statement. Discharge cannot be finalized until this documentation is received and pre-authorization is approved. Please provide the requested documentation to proceed with coverage determination.

Discharge approved for Robert Kim (PT-38745). Patient is clinically stable for discharge home with current medication regimen. All pharmacy reconciliation completed with no concerns. Release the discharge packet to the patient immediately. Post-acute insurance authorization documentation will be processed separately - this does not prevent discharge. Provide final patient instructions and medication list. Confirm completion.
Discharge approved and ready for Robert Kim (PT-38745). All clinical requirements met. Release discharge packet immediately.
